raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`ForwardBatch` fills `global_num_token_non_padded` (and the per-rank `num_token_non_padded` derived from it) only when `enable_num_token_non_padded()` is true, which today means expert parallelism (`moe_ep_size > 1`) or a WORLD-group DP gather.

`--moe-a2a-backend customized` is the extension point for an out-of-tree dispatcher. The predicate leaves the count unset for it whenever `moe_ep_size` is 1 and no WORLD-group DP gather is enabled, so a dispatcher selected through that option receives no real-token count to mask the padded rows of a CUDA-graph bucket with.

## Modifications

- `enable_num_token_non_padded()` also returns true when the A2A backend is `customized`. The import is local, like the existing `get_moe_a2a_backend` import elsewhere in `forward_batch_info.py`.
- The field comment on `global_num_token_non_padded` no longer names `moe_ep_size > 1` as the only condition; the predicate is the single statement of when the count is present.
- `test/registered/unit/model_executor/test_num_token_non_padded_localization.py` gains one CPU case pinning that at EP 1 the predicate is true for `customized` and false for `none`. With only the test applied to `main`, the `customized` subtest fails; on this branch it passes.

No behavior changes for any in-tree A2A backend: `none`, `deepep`, `mooncake`, `nixl`, `mori`, `flashinfer`, the Ascend backends and the MegaMoE variants keep the existing gate.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: the change only fills a count that existing backends already receive under EP, and no in-tree backend selects `customized`. The CPU unit file passes on this head (7 tests, 46 subtests), and `isort`, `ruff`, `ruff format` and `codespell` from the repository's pre-commit config are clean on both changed files.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

None run; the added work is one scalar host-to-device copy per forward, and only for the `customized` backend at EP 1.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation (no user-facing documentation changes).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (not applicable).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -672,8 +672,7 @@ class ForwardBatch(ForwardBatchDeepSeekMHAMixin):
     #                                      the eager forward and the cuda-graph
     #                                      registry localize from on each forward /
     #                                      replay. Present only when
-    #                                      enable_num_token_non_padded()
-    #                                      (moe_ep_size > 1).
+    #                                      enable_num_token_non_padded().
     #     global_num_token_non_padded_cpu  host int. Host-side attention/backend
     #                                      slices read it directly; the prefill
     #                                      graph registry derives its per-rank GPU
@@ -2102,8 +2101,15 @@ def can_run_tbo(self):
 
 
 def enable_num_token_non_padded():
-    # Elastic joiners also need graph padding masked after joining WORLD.
-    return get_parallel().moe_ep_size > 1 or world_dp_gather_enabled()
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import get_moe_a2a_backend
+
+    # Elastic joiners also need graph padding masked after joining WORLD; a
+    # customized A2A backend consumes the count whatever the EP size.
+    return (
+        get_parallel().moe_ep_size > 1
+        or world_dp_gather_enabled()
+        or get_moe_a2a_backend().is_customized()
+    )
 
 
 def build_inner_fb_view(

@@ -29,13 +29,15 @@
 import torch
 
 from sglang.srt.layers.moe import utils as moe_utils
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import MoeA2ABackend
 from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import (
     ForwardBatch,
     ForwardMode,
     compute_local_num_token_non_padded,
     compute_local_num_token_non_padded_cpu,
+    enable_num_token_non_padded,
 )
-from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_flags, get_parallel
 from sglang.test.communicator_patch import patch_communicator
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
@@ -235,5 +237,22 @@ def test_absent_local_count_stays_absent(self):
                 self.assertIsNone(_value(_forward_batch(sharded=False, local=None)))
 
 
+class TestEnableNumTokenNonPadded(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_customized_a2a_backend_fills_the_count_at_ep1(self):
+        """At EP 1 without a WORLD-group DP gather, the customized backend
+        enables the count and `none` leaves it disabled."""
+        for backend, expected in (
+            (MoeA2ABackend.NONE, False),
+            (MoeA2ABackend.CUSTOMIZED, True),
+        ):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(backend=backend.value),
+                get_parallel().override(moe_ep_size=1),
+                get_flags().moe.override(a2a_backend=backend),
+                get_flags().dp.override(use_world_group_for_gather=False),
+            ):
+                self.assertIs(enable_num_token_non_padded(), expected)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
